LHX.sentence: L3Harris is up slightly today and sits well below its past highs — it's the smallest of the big defense contractors and tends to trade cheaper than the others, so the business is steady even if the stock has lagged.

ASML.sentence: ASML eased back a touch and remains quite expensive, which is normal for the only company in the world that makes a certain kind of chipmaking machine — nothing's really changed, it's just pricey.

LIN.sentence: Linde is having a quiet stretch, sitting right in the middle of its range — industrial gas demand is steady and they keep nudging prices up a little, which is the whole story with this one.

MSFT.sentence: No data came through on Microsoft today, so there's nothing new to report.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher slipped a bit, but biotech funding is thawing again, and more money flowing to labs usually means more orders for their equipment a few quarters down the line.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge ticked up and keeps paying a solid dividend — it runs oil and gas pipelines like toll roads, so its income is steady, though it's not especially cheap right now.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow is flat on the day but down sharply from its highs, which is unusual for a company whose AI-automation tools keep winning long-term contracts with big companies and the federal government — it looks like a rare chance to own a strong business cheaper.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore dipped along with copper prices, but it's holding up better than pure copper miners because its trading arm and mix of metals cushion the swings.

MLM.sentence: Martin Marietta is roughly flat, and while the stock has pulled back, the price it gets per ton of crushed stone is still rising faster than its costs — the business moat is intact and the dip is just the normal construction cycle.

KOF.sentence: Coca-Cola FEMSA edged higher with the Mexican peso in a normal range — this Latin American Coke bottler is just quietly doing its thing.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras jumped again as oil sits near a cycle high, but it's run up so hard and fast that it's looking stretched in the short term.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the Danish container-shipping giant, rose today and is trading below what its fleet of ships would cost to replace — a cheap price for a bellwether of global trade.

MA.sentence: Mastercard rose and, unusually, is now priced the same as Visa even though it normally commands a premium — a rare moment where it looks relatively inexpensive while people keep tapping their cards more than ever.

ISRG.sentence: The da Vinci surgical robot company was basically flat today and sits well below its highs, but hospitals keep doing more procedures on its machines — and since most of the money comes from per-surgery supplies, that's the part that matters.
